summary: No blocker or major findings. Independent re-derivation of Phase C from git blobs (e939a28 vs HEAD, ordered rule signatures per context) reproduces exactly the 1,993 removed rules (296 DEAD, 1,697 DUP) with identical file/line/category to css-dead-rules-removed.txt. All 296 DEAD rules have every class/id token absent from the full corpus (public, server.js, routes, lib, scripts, tests, cached Bootstrap JS/CSS, Font Awesome, Remixicon, plus md/svg/txt), none matches a runtime-built prefix/suffix, none overlaps Edge runtime coverage (0 conflicts), and none is also present on main (main has no CSS changes and its JS adds no use of these tokens). All 1,697 DUP rules are earlier copies with an identical later kept copy in the same file and context. No @font-face, @keyframes, :root, nested or attribute-selector rule was removed, and app-theme.css and chat-reactions.css are byte-identical. The diff is pure line deletion (git diff --minimal: 0 insertions). A fresh 14-page x 4-viewport snapshot of HEAD compared with css-baseline gives 56 files, 0 differing cells (formularz and recipients include their 3 states). build-css.js is deterministic (two runs sha256 02bd3211..., LF only, 0 CR bytes), styles.deduped.min.css is byte-identical to e939a28 (frozen, never regenerated), --force is required to overwrite it, and the drift numbers (326/14/59/40) reproduce. Link order is unchanged on all 16 pages except the single intended href swap on leaderboard.html in the same position. Phase D is correctly dropped with concrete rect-level evidence and nothing committed. sw.js is CACHE_NAME prezenty-v128 (main is v127), 40 unique urlsToCache entries all present on disk, ?v bumps match exactly the files whose bytes changed. tests/, package-lock.json, server.js, routes, lib and all JS except sw.js are untouched. Reported numbers are real: byte table sums (764,491 -> 428,813, -335,678) and transfer totals recompute, e2e logs show 121/0/11 (reference) and 120/1/11 for the recorded flaky first run, and my canary run (smoke wrapping no-horizontal-overflow a11y) gave 39 passed, 10 skipped. Two minor cosmetic/doc findings remain. Note for the finalize step: tmp-css-*.js and .agents/tasks/css-baseline/tmp-css-snapshot.js are still in the tree/untracked by design and are to be removed there; public/sw.js will conflict with main (v127 + recipients precache entries) and must be resolved as the report describes.

findings.description: The safelist comments for /col-/ and /fa-users/ cite public/aws-design.css:1058 and :2506. Those lines moved to 1008 and 2456 after Phase C edited aws-design.css on this same branch, and aws-design.css is not a PurgeCSS input (the only input is public/styles.css, which has no [class*=] selector at e939a28), so these two patterns are not justified for the build they configure. /col-/ is also unanchored and broad (matches any token containing 'col-'). No served byte is affected because the generated file is frozen.
findings.required_fix: Optional: drop the two patterns or re-justify them against styles.css, and refresh the line references so each safelist pattern cites a real file:line.

findings.description: After removing their only rules, 8 @media blocks now contain just a comment (aws-design.css:3210 '@media (max-width: 991px) { /* Keep action cards visible on mobile */ }', and 7 in styles.css, e.g. lines 94, 203, 225). The plan says to delete an at-rule block when it becomes empty. They are harmless (no visual effect, snapshot 0 diffs) but leave dead scaffolding and orphaned comments.
findings.required_fix: Optional: delete the comment-only @media blocks in a follow-up with the same snapshot proof, or note the leftover in css-dead-rules-removed.txt.
